model_config.host_context: Paired conventional CLI CPU and CUDA runs, 16 pinned CPU threads. One run per backend at distinct indices of one fresh model commitment, using the exact production candidate. Every proof independently verified and changed model rejected.

note: RFC-0026 development tier (RFC-0018 A1): no security level, FS unproven, PCS conjectural. dev-zk profile byte 4 (balanced policy-2 hiding sources, RFC-0013 A8; RFC-0026 A9), development tier; zero knowledge is conditional and computational (seed-derived masks). The weights and the 1-D records (RFC-0013 A7) are committed once by commit-model as one published commitment for P = 8 proofs (A6), recorded as stage model_commitment_once and not part of the prove time. Prover time is the prove-dev --zk process wall time of proof index 1: Artifact decode, executor capture, plain check and proof (witness_recompute_ns 0). Verifier time is verify-dev with --expect-model; another proof against the same commitment also verifies. The control is verify-dev of a proof pinned to another model digest. Repeats, if any, are in model_config.host_context. Soundness ledger (verify-dev, E12-26): eps_interactive <= 731241032/p^4; worst round LU+ZD check 5, 2^-95.4, grinding 0 bits. CPU only, no GPU. Peak RSS is the GNU time -v maximum resident set size. Not a cost-model fit input.
